how_to_update: EASIEST: Edit this JSON file directly — add entry to overrides.cards, overrides.evos, overrides.heroes, overrides.meta, overrides.placements, overrides.reaction_cache
Example card: "Hog Rider": {"elixir": 4, "damage": 317, "hitpoints": 1408, "dps": 198, "reason": "Sep 2026 no change", "date": "2026-09-22", "changed": true}
Example evo: "Evo Cannon": {"win_rate": 50.8, "tier": "A", "reason": "Still best vs hog after nerf", "date": "2026-09-22", "changed": true}
Example hero: "Hero Ice Golem": {"win_rate": 49.4, "tier": "B", "reason": "Safe to upgrade", "date": "2026-09-22", "changed": true}
Example meta: "Hog 2.6 Evo Musk Evo Cannon Hero Ice Golem": {"win_rate": 64.1, "usage": 5.2, "reason": "Best meta 2621 battles", "date": "2026-09-22", "changed": true}
Example placement: "Cannon 4-3": {"still_valid": true, "adjustment": null, "reason": "Standard center pull still best vs Hog", "date": "2026-09-22", "changed": false}
Example spell reduction: "Lightning": {"current": "25% of full damage (75% reduction)", "reason": "June 2026 still 25%", "date": "2026-09-22", "changed": true}

Example reaction cache: "Hog Rider": {"counters": [["Cannon", "4-3 Standard Center Pull"], ["Skeletons", "Middle Distract"], ["Ice Spirit", "On Top Enemy Hog"]], "elixir": 4, "reason": "Cannon 4-3 still best", "date": "2026-09-22", "changed": true}

After editing, restart AI or call BalanceManager.apply_overrides_to_runtime() — it patches CARDS_DB, EVOS_DB, HEROES_DB, META_DECKS, PLACEMENTS at runtime — knowledge.py and meta.py and placement.py auto-apply on import

All updates validated — elixir 1-10, damage >=0, hp >=0, win_rate 0-100, tier S/A/B/C/D/E — 1% error margin
History saved automatically in config/balance_history/ — rollback easy — keeps last 20
Verification after save — checks file content matches what was intended — not instantly saying done without checking — BalanceManager saves and verifies
balance_sources: In-game news — balance changes every month first Monday
typical_balance_changes: Card elixir cost: e.g., Cannon 3 -> 4 (nerf), Hog Rider 4 -> 3 (buff) — update overrides.cards[Card].elixir
Card damage: e.g., Hog Rider Damage 317 -> 333 (+5%) — update overrides.cards[Card].damage and dps
Card hitpoints: e.g., Cannon HP 742 -> 800 — update overrides.cards[Card].hitpoints
Evo win rate: e.g., Evo Cannon Win rate 50.8% -> 49.5% — update overrides.evos[Evo].win_rate
Hero win rate: e.g., Hero Ice Golem Win rate 49.4% -> 50.2% — update overrides.heroes[Hero].win_rate
Meta win rate: e.g., Hog 2.6 Win rate 64.1% -> 62.0% — update overrides.meta[Deck].win_rate
Placement: rarely changes, but if building range changes, placement might need adjustment — update overrides.placements[Placement].adjustment
Reaction cache: if meta changes, best counters might change — update overrides.reaction_cache[Threat].counters
